<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>BBQ Outpost SNS Manager V7.6.1</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#0f172a;--card:#111827;--line:#334155;--text:#e5e7eb;--muted:#94a3b8;--accent:#ef4444;--orange:#f97316;--blue:#0284c7;--green:#16a34a}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0b1120,#111827);color:var(--text);font-family:Arial,'Noto Sans KR',sans-serif;padding-bottom:76px}.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:auto;padding:14px}.top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 0 14px}.brand{font-size:20px;font-weight:900}.pill{font-size:11px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 8px;color:#fecaca}.card{background:rgba(17,24,39,.96);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:14px;margin:10px 0;box-shadow:0 12px 30px #0005}h2,h3{margin:0 0 10px}.muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}textarea,input,select{width:100%;background:#020617;color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;padding:11px;font-size:15px}textarea{min-height:270px;resize:vertical}button{border:0;border-radius:11px;padding:12px 14px;font-weight:800;color:white;background:var(--orange);cursor:pointer}.secondary{background:#334155}.blue{background:var(--blue)}.green{background:var(--green)}.row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.row>*{flex:1}.output{white-space:pre-wrap;background:#020617;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;min-height:180px}.view{display:none}.view.active{display:block}.storyGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:320px 1fr;gap:14px;align-items:start}.storyWrap{background:#020617;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:10px;display:flex;justify-content:center}.storyWrap canvas{width:min(100%,540px);height:auto;border-radius:12px;display:block}.nav{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:#020617;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);z-index:20}.nav button{border-radius:0;background:#020617;padding:11px 4px;font-size:12px}.nav button.active{background:#1f2937;color:#fecaca}.locrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr auto;gap:8px;margin:7px 0}.status{padding:8px 10px;border-radius:10px;background:#071023;color:#bae6fd;font-size:13px}.danger{background:#b91c1c}@media(max-width:760px){.grid,.storyGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.wrap{padding:10px}.card{border-radius:14px;padding:12px}.storyWrap{padding:6px}textarea{min-height:220px}.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr}.locrow{grid-template-columns:88px 1fr auto}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
